title: Wheelchair access
summary: Door widths, route widths, turning space and thresholds against the ADA 2010 Standards and the Fair Housing Act Design Manual.

rules.text: Every door into or between living spaces gives at least 32 in (815 mm) of clear width with the door open at 90 degrees. Closets and voids are left out.
rules.standard: ADA 2010 Standards 404.2.3 (32 in, 815 mm minimum); Fair Housing Act Design Manual, Requirement 3 (usable doors: a nominal 32 in clear, which HUD accepts from 31 5/8 in)

rules.text: The walking route from the entrance to each bedroom, bathroom, kitchen and living space is at least 36 in (914 mm) wide between walls.
rules.standard: ADA 2010 Standards 403.5.1 (36 in, 915 mm; may narrow to 32 in for 24 in at most); Fair Housing Act Design Manual, Requirement 4 (accessible route into and through the unit, 36 in)

rules.text: Bathrooms, kitchens, bedrooms and living rooms hold a 60 in (1525 mm) turning circle in the empty room.
rules.standard: ADA 2010 Standards 304.3.1 (circular turning space, 60 in, 1525 mm diameter minimum; 304.3.2 allows a T-shaped space instead)

rules.text: No doorway has a change in level over 1/2 in (13 mm). Sill heights in the scan scatter by about 4 cm even on flat floors, so only larger steps show; small ones need a tape measure.
rules.standard: ADA 2010 Standards 404.2.5 (thresholds 1/2 in, 13 mm maximum) and 303.2 to 303.4 (1/4 in may be vertical, up to 1/2 in beveled at 1:2, more must be ramped)
